The frame requires non-aborted connection and connected target; explicit link focus is retained across native hash rescheduling, then scrollIntoView runs. No programmatic history write.

New chapter selection cancels pending animation; click microtask checks abort before resolution. Disconnect aborts the connection controller, removes signal-owned listeners and cancels its frame. Reconnection aborts the previous controller. Stale queued work cannot write history; only native links do.

Only after generate returns does CLI render/write hooks, configuration and optional existing changelog, then load Academy source/topic map, publish Academy and finally generate release applicability. Installer token counts are exact per OS, checksum text canonical, SHA256 matches actual installer bytes and both checksum/installer bytes equal Git show of observed commit. No successful current course is returned after a thrown action/render/write error. The old delete-first intermediate state is retired separately.

Observed Git HEAD is recorded while Home/lesson guide/action bytes are read from working files. Only installer/checksum bytes are separately compared to committed bytes. No global guide/action cleanliness check exists; this caveat is preserved, not a claim that all rendered content equals the source commit.
